name: receiptor
description: Get your receipts and invoices ready for your accountant. Find documents, check expense categories, and prepare a draft monthly pack for review.

interface.shortDescription: Find receipts, check expense categories, and prepare monthly document packs.
interface.longDescription: Use the receipts and invoices in your Receiptor AI account to check document details, review expense categories, and see totals by supplier or month. Prepare a draft pack with a spreadsheet, available original files, and a note explaining what needs your accountant's review.
defaultPrompt: Prepare last month's document pack for my accountant to review.
Find my receipts from a supplier and check their dates and amounts.
Check this supplier's expense categories and show me any suggested changes.
